description: Read one extension's user-count, store rating-count and average-star history with current metrics and deltas. Use for time-series analysis, not keyword ranks. Missing days are not zero values.

days.description: Look back this many days for stored metric snapshots, up to 365; coverage may be incomplete.

eid.description: 32-letter Chrome Web Store extension ID (a-p), not a URL, name or slug. Example: cjpalhdlnbpafiamejdnhcphjbkeiagm.

locale.description: Preferred response content language, not a review-language filter or a store search market.

name: extension_trends
